definitions.explanation: A rectangular block of clay hardened by drying or firing, used in building construction.

examples.japanese: {煉瓦|れんが}{造|づく}りの{建物|たてもの}は{丈夫|じょうぶ}だ。
{赤|あか}い{煉瓦|れんが}の{倉庫|そうこ}が{観光|かんこう}{名所|めいしょ}になっている。
examples.english: The red brick warehouse has become a tourist attraction.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{煉瓦|れんが}で{花壇|かだん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a flower bed with bricks in the garden.

notes:
USAGE: {煉瓦|れんが} can also be written as レンガ in katakana in modern usage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{煉瓦|れんが}{造|づく}り (brick construction)
・{煉瓦|れんが}を{積|つ}む (to stack/lay bricks)
・{赤|あか}{煉瓦|れんが} (red brick)

COUNTER: {個|こ} or {枚|まい}

CULTURAL NOTE: Red brick ({赤|あか}{煉瓦|れんが}) buildings from the Meiji era are often preserved as historical landmarks in Japan, particularly in Yokohama, Hakodate, and other port cities that were early to adopt Western architecture.
